dataTransforms.description:
List of data transform types, which will be applied after the data is
received but before saving it in the state.

Constraint: These types must extend {@link UiSdlDataTransform}.

format.description: Specifies the format options of the param kind

valueType.description:
Specifies how to transform the extracted value. The default is string, but depending on the use case
it may be useful to transform the value to a value type like numbers, arrays, etc.

params.description: Map of {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam} to resolve. Return value will have each element in the map resolved.

action.description:
Action to be executed with the resolved params. Note that it differs from other actions in that
this string defines a function body, so it must contain a return statement.


The params can be referred to by their key in the {@link #params} field.

title: UiSdlMultiDynamicValueParam with the ability to provide an action to be executed.
name: UiMultiDynamicValueWithActionParam
